What can go on the compost heap?

A good compost heap thrives on balance. Some materials break down quickly and feed soil life, while others disrupt the process or don't belong there at all.

⚠️ Common mistake

A compost heap is not a trash bin.

❌ Don't ask: "Can I get rid of this here?"
✅ Instead ask: "Can my compost heap safely turn this into food for the soil?"
